set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=85869b350d77d244993812bfec3787e2a9e38e58; BRANCH=integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903; git fetch origin "$BRANCH"; git checkout --detach "$EXPECTED"; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; echo SOURCE_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD); . ~/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh >/dev/null; cd tests/zigbee_device_emulator; if [ ! -f build/zigbee_device_emulator.elf ]; then echo '=== REBUILD IAS ELF ==='; rm -f sdkconfig sdkconfig.old; rm -rf build; idf.py set-target esp32c6 >/dev/null; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('sdkconfig')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('CONFIG_EMULATOR_PROFILE_MIXED=y','# CONFIG_EMULATOR_PROFILE_MIXED is not set\nCONFIG_EMULATOR_PROFILE_IAS_CONTACT=y')
p.write_text(s)
PY
idf.py reconfigure >/dev/null; idf.py build >/dev/null; fi; ELF=build/zigbee_device_emulator.elf; test -f "$ELF"; echo ELF=$ELF; echo '=== IAS CONFIG ==='; grep -E 'CONFIG_EMULATOR_PROFILE_(IAS_CONTACT|MIXED)=|CONFIG_ESP_CONSOLE_USB_SERIAL_JTAG=' sdkconfig || true; echo '=== ADDR2LINE ==='; riscv32-esp-elf-addr2line -pfiaC -e "$ELF" 0x42030dd5 0x42030dd8 0x408075e0 0x4080759e; echo '=== NEAREST SYMBOLS ==='; riscv32-esp-elf-nm -n -C "$ELF" | awk '$1 >= "42030c00" && $1 <= "42030f80" {print}'; echo '=== APP SYMBOLS ==='; riscv32-esp-elf-nm -n -C "$ELF" | grep -E 'initialize_ias_contact_attributes|register_selected_profile|zigbee_task|app_main|esp_zigbee_start|ezb_zcl_set_attr_value' || true
